fragments.text: Thank you very much for inviting us to engage on this year's AI for Information Access Conference. My name is Tia Mohamed Zafar. I'm the Director for the African Open Science Platform, a new and exciting initiative to spearhead open science in the continent and to particularly also enhance collaboration in the continent around projects for addressing societal challenges. And I think this platforms activities are very relevant to this year's conference that we are running. Primarily because the issue of AI presupposes availability of data. That's from which you can derive information. So I think for the African continent, the great challenge is what is the data? How coordinated are we to make that data available?
